title: ChatHealthy ProviderMedicare
description: One ProviderMedicare record: one molecule per provider (EPIC-010-F-007-S-002-REQ-B-001). _id is the pair {npi, molecule_id}. Built by CMS_NPI_PrescriberBase from the CMS Part D file alone -- brand names and generic names as arrays, total claims and total day supply as sums over every source row for that prescriber and molecule (REQ-B-006) -- then completed by enrichment from the Provider collection and the FDA molecule collection: billing state, entity type, NUCC codes (REQ-B-002, REQ-B-003), CCN and size tier for an organization (REQ-B-011, REQ-B-012), the FDA block and the indications (REQ-B-009, REQ-B-010). Each year's construction fully replaces the collection (REQ-B-015).

_id.description: The record key: NPI and molecule (REQ-B-001).

npi.description: The prescriber NPI the key names.

molecule_id.description: The molecule the key names; the join key to fdaProductToDiagnosisResolution.

entity_type.description: Individual or organization, from the Provider collection (REQ-B-002); null when the NPI is in no Provider record.

nucc_codes.description: NUCC taxonomy codes as the Provider collection gives them (REQ-B-003).

medicare_population.description: The population the drug facts belong to (REQ-B-005).

brand_names.description: Every brand name the source gives for this molecule and provider (REQ-B-006).

generic_names.description: The generic name or names as the source gives them (REQ-B-006).

tot_clms.description: Total claims summed across the folded source rows; null when every row's value is suppressed (REQ-B-006, REQ-B-008).

tot_day_suply.description: Total day supply summed across the folded source rows; null when every row's value is suppressed.

record_count.description: How many Part D source rows folded into this record.

fda.description: Molecule-level FDA facts, taken from the molecule's record in fdaProductToDiagnosisResolution by molecule_id.

drug_class.description: SET: a molecule can carry both OTC and Rx labels.

identity.description: Union of rxcui/unii/substance_name across the molecule's labels.

indications.description: chatHealthy.ai indications for the molecule, each keeping the trust of its association (REQ-B-009, REQ-B-010).

ccn.description: An organizational provider's CCN; null where the NPI is not enrolled (REQ-B-011).

size_tier.description: An organizational provider's size, one of five ordered tiers; null where no CCN or bed count resolves (REQ-B-012).

source_state.description: The CMS prescriber state the record's rows arrived under. It is the fan-out key for the steps after the base, and drop_transient_attributes_and_records removes it once the records are settled.

contributed_by.description: The units of work whose contributions this record carries. The write is gated on a unit's marker being absent, which is what makes a re-driven unit a no-op.

billing_state.description: The provider's billing state from the Provider collection, attached by enrichment; null when the NPI is in no Provider record.

rxcui_in.description: The RxNorm ingredient RXCUI this record's molecule resolves to (RXNCONSO TTY=IN). The identifier this record joins to the FDA molecule collection on.

unii.description: The FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier of that ingredient. FDA assigns a UNII permanently and never reuses it.

identity_path.description: Which rung of the identity ladder answered: the CMS Brnd_Name or the CMS Gnrc_Name.
